note: The fixed scenes of the performance budget (docs/design/performance.md), measured by `dyno bench`. cameras: names in tools/concepts/cameras.json (the gauntlet's gameplay cameras). flight: straight runs between points, metres from the world's hearth (x east, z south), a few metres over the ground. tiers: the player's settings each tier pins (crates/dyno-client/src/settings.rs); default_tier is what a new player gets and what the budgets hold. world: the size and seed of the world `--local` builds.
